title: SPLA/16/2015 of State Of Uttarakhand Vs Akhilesh Joshi

paras.text:
SPLA No. 16 of 2015
With
CRMA No. 116 of 2015
In
GA No. 11 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. D.K. Sharma, Deputy Advocate
General for the appellant / State.
Mr. M.C. Pandey, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate for
the respondent.
Having heard Mr. D.K. Sharma,
learned Deputy Advocate General for the
appellant / State as well as Mr. M.C. Pandey,
learned Senior Advocate for the accused /
respondent, the facts of the case transpire
that victim was in her teens and went to take
tuition from the accused (teacher), who was
having a keen eyes to court the victim. In
furtherance to his motive, the accused
squeezed the bosom of the victim and
offered a cup of tea mixed with some
intoxicants. Next day, somehow, the
accused could prepare the video clipping of
her bare breasts and other private parts.
Looking into the gravity of the
incident, we are inclined to condone the
delay as well as grant special leave to appeal.
Accordingly, delay is condoned. Leave
to appeal is granted.
 Application seeking leave to appeal is
allowed.
GA No. 11 of 2015

Admit the appeal.
 Call the L.C.R.
List this appeal after paper book is
prepared and copies thereof are supplied to
the learned counsel for the parties in
accordance with Rules.
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Alok Singh, J.)
 06.05.2015
Shiv
